notes: WIBOR: GPW Benchmark dane-opoznione (fetched 2026-11-27, HTTP 200 on the first request; rolling table 2026-01-02..2026-11-25). Only the rows dated C were extracted. Later text on the page (ON/SW discontinuation from 1 Oct 2026) post-dates the window and was ignored. Cross-check: Erste Codziennik issued C+1, table 'Stawki WIBOR' (no 1Y). Ids: 169396, 169401, 169402, 169407, 169409, 169416, 169421, 169422, 169425, 169429, 169434, 169438, 169442, 169443, 169446, 169448, 169452, 169454, 169462, 169465 for C=30 Apr, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 11, 12, 13, 14, 15, 18, 19, 20, 21, 22, 25, 26, 27, 28 May. ON/SW/1M/3M/6M match GPWB on all 20 C. On every issue, value minus the change column reproduces the previous GPWB fixing (for C=30 Apr: 29 Apr; for C=4 May: 30 Apr). Header labels are C on 19 of 20 issues; the exception is 169396 (see next note). No issue is missing and no WIBOR table is stale. 1Y is single source; WIBID is stored too (single source).

Erste exceptions. (1) R=4 May issue 169396 (for C=30 Apr) is headed 01.05.2026 in both 'Poprzednia sesja na rynku FX' and 'Rynek stopy procentowej', although 1 May was a Polish holiday. Its WIBOR table is the 30 Apr fixing with changes vs 29 Apr (ON 3.47 -10, SW 3.82 +1, 1M 3.76 -2, 3M 3.84 -1, 6M 3.88 -1). Its fixing column is NBP 30 Apr (083/A, 4.2589/3.6460). Its FX session row is 1 May offshore trading (EURPLN 4.2406-4.2573, close 4.2436). Every PL IRS, FRA and bond-benchmark change is 0 because the changes are measured against 30 Apr. The levels themselves are the 30 Apr close: against the 30 Apr issue 169390 (headed 29.04), IRS 1L +3, 2L +1, 3L -1, 4L/5L -2, 8L -4, 10L -5bp; FRA +2..+5 beyond 1x4; DS1035 -3, PS0131 -1, OK0128 0. This matches the issue text ('before the long weekend shorter yields unchanged, longer 1-3bp lower, likewise IRS'). US IRS changes (+0..+3) are 1 May moves; EZ +0/+1. Use the levels for C=30 Apr, but do not read the zero changes as 29->30 Apr moves. (2) R=5 May issue 169401 (C=4 May, headed 04/05/2026): WIBOR, fixing column and FX session are correct for 4 May, but the PL IRS table is STALE. All 7 tenors (4.27/4.44/4.47/4.51/4.55/4.68/4.76) are identical to the 30 Apr close in 169396, every change is 0, and the 6 May issue's changes are measured against those same values. 4 May was the UK Early May bank holiday; the issue text says IRS/FRA were stable on limited activity. FRA (+2/-1/-1/-1/-2/-4) and bonds were updated. Its 2L row is still labelled OK0128 at 4.67 (+13), which contradicts its own text ('2Y yields fell slightly on Monday'). The next issue (169402) switches to WS0428 4.68 (+1) and PS0731 5.50 (+1), so the 2L/5L rows of 169401 probably carry the new benchmarks under the old labels, with roll-artefact changes. (3) R=26 May issue 169452 (C=25 May, Whit Monday): IRS changes 0..+1 and FRA ~0 while bond yields fell up to 10bp. The text attributes this to London/US investors being absent and says FRA and IRS were practically unchanged. The quotes are thin, not identical, so not flagged as stale. (4) R=19 May issue 169438 (C=18 May): its bond table shows WS0428 -6 and DS1035 +8, while its text says the curve rose 1-2bp (IRS +0..+3 fits the text). This is a table/text conflict for curve agents; WIBOR and the fixing column are correct.

1 May 2026 (Labour Day): GPW Benchmark did NOT fix on 1 May. There is no WIBOR/WIBID row and no POLSTR/WIRON index date 2026-05-01. The POLSTR CI accrues 4 days at the 30 Apr rate from 30 Apr to 4 May (implied 3.0660 vs POLSTR 3.066), so 1 May was not a GPWB business day. The only '01.05' in the data is the Erste header above; its content is the 30 Apr fixing. Also absent on 1 May: an NBP table (083/A = 30 Apr, 084/A = 4 May), EURIBOR ('Kein Wert', TARGET holiday), PRIBOR (CZ holiday), BUBOR (HU holiday) and a Catalyst session (catalyst_20260501.xls returns 302 to page-404; the May month list starts on 4 May). Sun 3 May is not a business day anywhere. By contrast, Whit Monday 25 May had a GPWB WIBOR fixing and a POLSTR index date, EURIBOR (TARGET open), PRIBOR, NBP 099/A and a Catalyst session; only BUBOR (HU holiday) was missing.

WIBOR 6M fixings 15-22 May (the 25 May-25 Nov WZ coupon uses an average of three fixings before the MoF notice): 15 May 3.90, 18 May 3.97, 19 May 3.96, 20 May 3.96, 21 May 3.96, 22 May 3.95 (GPWB; the Erste C+1 table agrees on every date). WIBOR 1Y on the same dates: 3.93, 4.06, 4.04, 4.04, 4.04, 4.01. Three-day averages: 15/18/19 = 3.943, 18/19/20 = 3.963, 19/20/21 = 3.960, 20/21/22 = 3.957. Which window applies depends on the MoF notice date, which was not determined here. The step on 18 May (6M +7bp, 1Y +13bp, 3M -1bp, SW -4bp) is printed by the Erste 19 May issue (6M 3.97, +7). It came after Erste's 15 May session note of IRS +11..+16bp (issue 169434).

WIBOR and the NBP: RPP held the reference rate at 3.75% on 6 May (Codziennik 7 May, id 169407). At the 7 May conference Glapinski said the probability of a hike was higher than a month earlier (Codziennik 8 May, id 169409). Ranges over the 20 C: ON 3.45 (6 May)-3.85 (22 May), SW 3.77-3.82, 1M 3.76-3.82, 3M 3.84-3.86, 6M 3.88 (30 Apr)-3.97 (18 May), 1Y 3.91 (30 Apr)-4.06 (18 May). Values are as published. GPWB's Q2 2026 WIBID/WIBOR error-impact report (post-window, PDF created 21 Jul 2026; read only to confirm that nothing was restated) says published fixings are never re-set. For Q2 it counts two WIBOR fixings that corrected inputs would have changed (6M -1bp, 1Y -2bp, published minus hypothetical) but gives no dates. The stored values are the published ones.

POLSTR/WIRON: keyed by index date ('Data wskaznika') from gpwbenchmark.pl/dane_opoznione (latest index date 2026-11-19). All 22 index dates 2026-04-28..2026-05-28 are present; there is no 1 May. The index dates equal the WIBOR fixing dates. CI accrual confirms the calendar: 30 Apr->4 May accrues 4 days and 8->11, 15->18 and 22->25 May 3 days; every step matches POLSTR x days/365 to 0.01. published_by_convention = next GPW Benchmark business day (d+1 rule, not verified with timestamps): 30 Apr -> 4 May (no GPWB fixing on 1 May), 22 May -> 25 May (GPWB operated on Whit Monday), 28 May -> 29 May. 28 and 29 Apr are identical to the 2026-04 file. Month-end dip: index 30 Apr POLSTR 3.066 / WIRON 2.254 (29 Apr 3.327/2.941; 4 May 3.473/3.019). Other low WIRON prints are in the source: 6-8 May 2.884/2.816/2.855, 21 May 2.966, 27 May 2.721, 28 May 2.799. POLSTR peaked at 3.690 on 22 May. The post-window GPWB Q2 2026 error-impact reports (2 Jul 2026) list WIRON index dates 12 May (impact 0.010-0.020pp) and 18 May (0.001-0.005pp), and no May date for POLSTR. Both reports say the history is not revised, so the published values stand.

EURIBOR: Bundesbank BBIG1 (published with a 1 working-day delay; values dated C; 'Stand vom 26.11.2026 13:24'). Single source, as in earlier runs. There is no value for 1 May (TARGET holiday). Every C has a value, including Whit Monday 25 May. 27-29 Apr are identical to the 2026-04 file. 12M: 2.848 (30 Apr) -> 2.883 (4 May, high) -> 2.708 (8 May, low) -> 2.860 (13 May) -> 2.722 (26 May) -> 2.761 (28 May). 3M: 2.199 -> 2.283 (13 May) -> 2.181 (20 May) -> 2.231. 1M: 1.903-1.988.

PRIBOR: CNB year.txt 2026 (last row 19 Nov). There are no rows for 1 May and 8 May (CZ holidays). C=8 May therefore has no PRIBOR fixing: by_date['2026-05-08'].pribor holds the latest earlier fixing, 7 May (3M 3.56, 6M 3.65, 1Y 3.75), and its src string says so. All other C are CZ fixing days. 27-29 Apr are identical to the 2026-04 file. 3M is 3.56-3.57 all month; 6M 3.65-3.70; 1Y 3.77 (30 Apr) -> 3.75 (7/8 May) -> 3.86 (19-20 May) -> 3.83 (28 May).

BUBOR: MNB bubor2.xls sheet 2026. There are no rows for 1 May and 25 May (HU holidays: Labour Day, Whit Monday). C=25 May therefore uses the latest earlier fixing, 22 May (date='2026-05-22': 6.04/5.99/5.89). All other C have date=C. BUBOR fell steadily from 13 May: 3M/6M/12M 6.25/6.25/6.31 (30 Apr) -> 6.25/6.23/6.20 (12 May) -> 6.19/6.16/6.12 (13 May) -> 6.08/6.04/5.96 (15 May) -> 6.04/5.99/5.89 (21-22 and 26 May) -> 6.00/5.94/5.83 (28 May). The cause was not researched (the May Codziennik issues do not mention the MNB). The values are as published.

NBP fx: api.nbp.pl table A 083..102/A/NBP/2026 for the C dates; there is no table on 1 May. EUR/USD fixings match the Codziennik fixing column on all 20 C (the 4 May issue shows NBP 30 Apr under its 01.05 header). EUR mid is 4.2352 in both 099/A (25 May) and 100/A (26 May). These are distinct tables with different USD (3.6374/3.6394) and CHF (4.6530/4.6388), so this is a genuine coincidence, not a duplicate. EUR 4.2284 (8 May)-4.2589 (30 Apr); USD 3.5921 (7 May)-3.6709 (20 May). CHF is single source.

Catalyst: PRIMARY = official GPW Catalyst daily statistics, gpwcatalyst.pl/pub/CATALYST/statystyki/statystyki_dzienne/catalyst_YYYYMMDD.xls (May files are still .xls; the 'instrumenty' layout is unchanged; one GPW RR row per FPC bond in every file). The month list for 05 has 20 sessions, 4-29 May; there is no 1 May. Header date = C in all 20 files. The off-session sheet has no FPC rows on any C, and the block columns are 0. All April files were re-downloaded for last-trade lookback; their FPC rows reproduce the 2026-04 output exactly (0 mismatches on 114 bond-days). Cross-check: biznesradar.pl notowania-historyczne pages 1-6. Open/high/low/close/vol are identical on all 94 traded bond-days, and none of the 26 no-trade bond-days has a biznesradar row. Last-trade dates and closes agree.

Catalyst file timing: HTTP Last-Modified is on C for all 20 files (16:43-20:15 UTC). The latest postings are 8 May 20:15 UTC (22:15 Warsaw), 30 Apr 18:45 UTC and 6 May 18:03 UTC, all before the next pre-open. Internal last-saved is on C 16:25-16:41 UTC, except 30 Apr, which reads 'Tue Mar 31 16:26:12 2026'. That is the same month-end metadata artefact noted in April; the header and content are 30 Apr (they match biznesradar).

Catalyst units: official nominal = 1,000 PLN per bond. vol = number of bonds. turnover_pln = official 'Wartosc obrotu' (thous. PLN x 1000, includes accrued interest). biznesradar 'Obrot' is only vol x price(%) and is 10.00-10.25x smaller. The ratio is exactly 10.00 for FPC0630 from 26 May, when its accrued interest is 0 (ex-coupon, see coupons).

Catalyst traded=false (26 bond-days): vol=0 and close = last trade close on last_trade_date. This is not a C price; it equals the official closing and reference price on C. FPC0231 traded only 30 Apr (31 bonds, 102.50), 7 May (15, 103.00), 13 May (10, 102.20) and 19 May (1,902 in 7 trades, 101.80-102.20, close 101.80). No trade: 4-6 May (last 30 Apr), 8/11/12 May (last 7 May), 14/15/18 May (last 13 May) and 20-28 May (last 19 May, stale for 7 sessions): 16 bond-days. FPC0229: no trade 5-6 May (last 4 May, 102.25, 204) and 25 May (last 22 May, 102.05, 999). FPC0733: no trade 5 May (last 4 May, 80.78, 142), 8 May (last 7 May, 81.23, 6), 15 May (last 14 May, 81.24, 2), 19-21 May (last 18 May, 81.24, ONE bond) and 28 May (last 27 May, 81.50, 167): 7 bond-days. FPC0630, FPC0235 and FPC0332 traded on every C.

Catalyst thin/suspicious (medians over traded C: FPC0229 108, FPC0630 321, FPC0231 23, FPC0733 19, FPC0235 2,104.5, FPC0332 84.5). FPC0630: on 4 May the open and high were 93.50 vs close 90.34 (one print ~3pt off); 6 May 1 bond at 89.06 (-0.92); 11 May +1.00 (566 bonds); 12 May 2 bonds; 18 May -1.00; 28 May 12,456 bonds in 22 trades (~39x median). FPC0229: 20 May range 101.51-103.45 (high 1.9pt above the close; 10 trades, 1,501 bonds); single-trade blocks of 962 (18 May) and 999 (22 May); 1,423 on 30 Apr; 2 bonds on 27 May. FPC0733: on 27 May the open and low were 78.22 vs close 81.50 (one print 3.3pt below; 3 trades, 167 bonds); 26 May +0.90 on 358 bonds in one trade; 18 May 1 bond, 14 May 2, 22 May 3; the close stayed at 81.24 from 12 to 21 May, and after 13 May it was held only by prints of 2 and 1 bonds. FPC0231: 19 May 1,902 bonds (~83x median). FPC0235: 6 May +1.29 to 101.39 on 11,935 bonds (RPP day; IRS -14..-16bp per Codziennik 7 May, id 169407); heavy volume 30 Apr 15,108 and 14 May 14,720; below par 15-19 May (low 99.60 on 18 May). FPC0332 whipsawed on small prints: 4 May -0.89 (50 bonds), 5 May +0.65 (4 bonds), 7 May -0.64 (6 bonds), 8 May +0.72.

Coupons: FPC0630 (2.125% annual, matures 2030-06-05, coupon on 5 Jun) went ex-coupon on Catalyst from 26 May. Its accrued interest is 20.73 on 25 May and 0.00 on 26-29 May, and from 26 May turnover = vol x price exactly, so trades settle without accrued. Its prices are clean on both sides of that date. No other bond has a coupon or record date in the window (FPC0229/0231/0235 pay on 3 Feb, FPC0332 on 3 Mar, FPC0733 on 21 Jul); their accrued interest rises monotonically on every C. FPC0332's coupon stays at 3.72%. Prices are clean.

New lines: no new BGK, FWSZ or PFR line in May. The BGK (ISIN PL00005...) and PFR instrument set is the same in every May file as on 30 Apr: BGK FPC0229, FPC0231, FPC0235, FPC0328, FPC0332, FPC0342, FPC0427, FPC0630, FPC0631, FPC0733, FPC1140, BGK1127, FPU1130, FWA0931, IWS0645; PFR PFR0330, PFR0627, PFR0827, PFR0927, PF10927. No FWSZ-named line exists. The only state-related addition is the Treasury zero-coupon OK0129 (PL0000119178, matures 2029-01-25), listed on GPW RR and BS RR from the 18 May file. DS0436 (listed 28 Apr) continues. No Treasury line was removed in May.

Other source notes: GPWB operational communiques list nothing dated 3 Apr-29 May 2026. Codziennik formats: dd/mm/yyyy with decimal points on 169401, 169402, 169407, 169409, 169425, 169429, 169442, 169446 and 169448; dd.mm.yyyy with commas on the rest. All May issues use the 4-page Erste Bank Polska layout. File-server stamps are 08:05-09:16 Warsaw on the issue date (none late), and PDF CreationDate is 05:45-07:15 UTC. Bond benchmarks in the Codziennik switch from OK0128/PS0131 to WS0428/PS0731 in the 6 May issue (169402). Erste IRS/FRA/bond change columns chain consistently, within 1bp rounding, from issue to issue for all 19 May issues; the exceptions are described above. Rates were used for levels only.

No gaps: every requested field for every C has a value, with no interpolation and nothing from memory. Holiday fallbacks are explicit: PRIBOR for C=8 May = 7 May fixing (src string says so); BUBOR for C=25 May = 22 May (bubor.date). Single-source fields: WIBOR 1Y, WIBID, NBP CHF, EURIBOR, PRIBOR, BUBOR, POLSTR/WIRON. For curve agents: the Erste PL IRS table of R=5 May (C=4 May) is the 30 Apr close, and the R=4 May table is headed 01.05 (levels = 30 Apr close, zero changes).
